personalAccessToken.description: Nodesty Personal Access Token, sent as `PAT <token>`.
personalAccessToken.name: Authorization

info.description:
Build integrations for your Nodesty account, services, billing, virtual servers, dedicated servers, and firewall resources.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints use permission-scoped **Personal Access Tokens (PAT)**. Create a token from [Dashboard → Access Tokens](/dashboard/my-account/access-tokens), then send it with every request:

```http
Authorization: PAT <your_personal_access_token>
```

> Keep access tokens server-side and never expose them in browser code or public repositories.

## Common responses

| Status | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| **200** | Request completed successfully. |
| **400** | The request parameters or payload are invalid. |
| **401** | Authentication is missing or invalid. |
| **403** | The token does not have the required permission. |
| **404** | The requested resource could not be found. |
| **429** | The request limit has been exceeded. |
